Meet Brandon

The only hands in your vehicle

Brandon Ruhl

Ruhl's Detail Center is a sole-proprietor auto detailing shop in Mifflinburg, PA. Owned and operated by Brandon Ruhl, the shop offers a wide range of services to keep your vehicle looking like new.

With over 17 years of experience, Brandon ensures that every vehicle receives the care it deserves. From basic detailing to ceramic coating, Ruhl's Detail Center provides a professional touch to every car that comes through the doors.

The shop is conveniently located at 916 Chestnut St, Mifflinburg, PA 17844. Call (570) 217-6105 to book your appointment.
